protocol.status: Controlled synthetic experiment; not fitted to a Martian region
protocol.time_convention: Myr elapsed since an assumed initial thermal state, not age before present
protocol.initial_state: Exact steady profile for the initial basal flux and heat production
protocol.parameter_basis: All column, heat-source and event parameters are explicit illustrative choices, not measured values or a reproduction of a published Mars thermal history. The effective heating half-life is not an isotope inventory. Thresholds reuse the existing project's illustrative ordering-temperature endmembers, not mineral identification or blocking spectra.
protocol.interpretation: An ordered magnetic carrier is excluded at or above its chosen ordering temperature. Staying below that threshold only avoids this exclusion; duration-dependent relaxation, chemical alteration, acquisition and magnetic field geometry are not modelled.

sources.use: Scientific context: thermal evolution depends on crustal structure and composition; this solver does not reproduce that parameterized mantle model.
Scientific context: cooling and field reversals affect magnetic recording; no code or dataset imported.
sources.consulted: Publisher abstract; full methods not audited here

sources.use: Limitation: magnetic stability depends on temperature, time and grain energy barriers, not solely Curie temperature.
sources.consulted: PMC full text, selected stability and methods sections; not a full methodological audit

protocol.reuse: Independently written solver, synthetic inputs and project-generated figures. No new external dataset, article figure or source code copied. No MCD or private internship material accessed.

validation.scope: Numerical verification against exact solutions and a finer grid; not geological validation

scenario_comparisons.interpretation: Deterministic numerical difference, not a geological uncertainty interval
Deterministic numerical difference, not a geological uncertainty interval

gate_codes.0: Ordering threshold never reached from this time onward; survival unresolved
gate_codes.1: Below threshold now, but reaches it later; older component thermally excluded
gate_codes.2: At or above ordering threshold at this time

provenance.display_sampling: 10 Myr normally, 0.125 Myr within 5 Myr of each pulse, 1 Myr for the next 95 Myr; all depth nodes. Future peaks computed at every integration step before thinning.
